name: zura-premiere-mcp
description: Inspect and edit local Adobe Premiere Pro projects through the Zura Premiere MCP.
long_description: Inspect projects, assemble and modify timelines, manage media, effects, audio and captions, and export deliverables through a local bridge to Adobe Premiere Pro.

premiere_uxp_token.title: Premiere UXP Token
premiere_uxp_token.description: Optional. Only needed for the Zura Advanced Bridge UXP panel. Generate any 16+ character secret yourself and enter the same value in Premiere. Leave blank to use the standard CEP panel.

premiere_mcp_protocol_mode.title: MCP protocol mode
premiere_mcp_protocol_mode.description: Leave blank or use auto for modern MCP negotiation. Set legacy only if Claude Desktop support directs you to bypass server/discover negotiation.
